sql: SELECT j.jobname, (convert_from(decode(rpad(translate(split_part(t.tok, '.', 2), '-_', '+/'), ((length(split_part(t.tok, '.', 2)) + 3) / 4) * 4, '='), 'base64'), 'utf8')::json ->> 'role') AS papel, j.command ILIKE '%vault%' AS usa_vault, CASE WHEN j.command ~ 'sb_secret_' THEN 'secret' WHEN j.command ~ 'sb_publishable_' THEN 'publishable' END AS chave_nova FROM cron.job j LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT substring(j.command from 'Bearer (eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)') AS tok) t ON true ORDER BY j.jobname
